headline: Rising Dividend and Buybacks Might Change The Case For Investing In McKesson (MCK)
summary: Earlier this week, McKesson Corporation announced a quarterly dividend of US$0.94 per share, payable on October 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the September 1, 2026 ex-dividend and record date. This higher payout highlights how McKesson is combining dividend growth with its existing share repurchase efforts, reinforcing management’s confidence in the company’s earnings power. Against this backdrop of a higher quarterly dividend, we’ll now examine how the announcement interacts with...
